description: Normalized event-level inputs used to reproduce data/wallets.seed.json without a private filesystem dependency.

metadata.population_definition: Successful ERC-20 Transfer events emitted by the QUID token contract, with `to` equal to one of the five supplied exchange wallets, from the contract creation block through the frozen safe cutoff block.
metadata.ranking_definition: Sum of raw QUID amounts by event-level indexed `from` address; ties are ordered by lowercase address. Exchange rankings aggregate all supplied wallets for that exchange.
metadata.discovery_source: Blockscout Base API v2 full filtered address history
caveats: The ranking identifies event-level sending addresses, not verified real-world owners.
A smart-contract sender can represent many underlying users; one user can also control many addresses.
The all-senders files include transfers from any of the five known exchange wallets; external-senders files exclude those known internal sources.
Only direct ERC-20 Transfer events into the supplied wallets are included. Transfers routed to unlisted exchange wallets are out of scope.
